transcript: Doctor, my daughter's ear has been hurting for two days. She was crying all night. She is six years old. Is there a fever? Yes, I have a slight fever. The temperature is one hundred and eight. I am looking for work. The eardrum has turned red. This is acute otitis media, meaning an ear infection. She doesn't have any medicine allergies. I give Amoxicillin syrup, 5 ml three times a day. Wait, what is its weight? Just measured 20 kilos. Then 5 ml will be reduced for 20 kg. Give Amoxicillin syrup 7.5 ml three times a day for seven full days. And only give Paracetamol syrup of 6 ml if you have a fever or earache. Anything else to worry about? If you have pus in your ear, have a fever, or your neck is stiff, bring it immediately. When to show it again? Return in 5 days.
